title: DocFusion: A Unified Framework for Document Parsing Tasks

layout.note: Three columns left to right (inputs with task tokens, one large grey model container, four stacked outputs); four task rows are kept parallel in colour through input, token and output; the container holds an encoder branch above an embedding branch that merge into a tall decoder; a colour key sits under the inputs.

lesson: For a unified multi-task model, give each task one colour and keep it on the input frame, the task token, the legend bar and the output box, and let thin curves converge into and fan out of one model container, so one architecture visibly serves several tasks.
